name: How do I choose the right drywall contractor for my home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right drywall contractor for my home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor who handles both hanging and finish work, provides transparent estimates, and maintains active licensure and BBB accreditation. Ask who will supervise the daily work on-site, as communication gaps frequently lead to misplaced outlets or unfinished seams. Abraham Becerra personally oversees projects at HH Remodeling, ensuring drywall integrates smoothly with existing carpentry, trim, and paint. Always confirm that your contractor checks framing straightness prior to installation, rather than merely covering up misaligned wall studs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an accredited contractor who inspects framing first, guarantees seamless mudding and finish work, and provides direct on-site project supervision.
